name: How long does a typical design consultation last?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical design consultation last?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical design consultation with AKN Design Group generally lasts between 60 to 90 minutes. This timeframe allows us to engage in a thorough discussion of your vision, conduct a detailed walkthrough of your property in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, and answer any questions you may have about our integrated design-build process. Our goal is to ensure we fully understand your needs for your customized renovation, whether it's for a whole-home remodel or a high-end outdoor living space, setting the stage for clear communication and a managed process that prioritizes your homeowner experience.
